description: Transmission lines in Cambodia (1999-2014) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset describes the information of transmission lines for each of Cambodia’s province from 1999 to 2014. The data was collected from many sources by ODC’s mappers such as government agency and final reports of Electricité du Cambodge (EDC) in pdf format.. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Electricity infrastructure, Energy, Hydropower dams. It offers 13 resource(s) in csv, db_table, geojson, html, jpeg. The portal shows 2021-06-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
